text:
maya: Quick ask - Skyline Telecom wants EU-only processing + control-plane in EU for their POC. Also BYOK (HSM) and signed subproc list. Need presales brief.

rick-ops: We have three viable patterns: hosted+geo-pin (fast), dedicated EU pool (reserved), or private control plane (full residency). Hosted+geo-pin still leaves control-plane metadata potentially outside EU.

sue-legal: If control-plane must be EU, hosted is a no-go unless we spin a private control plane. I can pull subproc export + SOC2 dates, and draft DPA addendum. Need customer contact for cert acceptance.

ben-pricing: Give me POC load and token profile and I9ll produce cost delta. Also note BYOK-HSM integration is typically a separate SOW.

maya: POC numbers: 6 qps baseline, 40 qps short spikes, ~100 tokens per request, 30 day POC.

infra-bot: Presales snippet:
```
routing: "sticky_tenant_pin: eu-west-1"
control_plane: "eu_only: true|false"
kms: "BYOK-HSM: mTLS, cert exchange"
fallback: "model_fallback: smaller-quant"
```
Add network: peering, ip allowlist, nat.

rick-ops: Ops caveat: BYOK-HSM over hosted requires outbound tunnels to customer HSM endpoints and cert stamping/testing. If customer firewalls block outbound, Private (VPC connector) required.

zoe-ml: Model note: 13B quantized should meet latency targets at this scale; include expected token/s latency in the brief.

ben-pricing: Ballpark: hosted+geo-pin ~2.3k/mo + one-time network ~3.5k. Dedicated reserved ~8.5k/mo. Private (EU control plane) ~16-20k/mo + integration SOW. Will refine for AE.

sue-legal: Action: I'll prep subproc export + DPA template.

maya: Action items: @ben send one-pager with decision matrix; @rick ops checklist & timeline; @sue subproc + DPA; @zoe add latency/quant notes. Handoff call tomorrow 11:00 CET. Thanks! :thumbsup:
